scripts.format: npx --no-install prettier --write 'src/**/*.{astro,css,md,ts}' 'tests/**/*.mjs' '.github/**/*.yml' README.md package.json astro.config.ts tsconfig.json .prettierrc.mjs
scripts.format:check: npx --no-install prettier --check 'src/**/*.{astro,css,md,ts}' 'tests/**/*.mjs' '.github/**/*.yml' README.md package.json astro.config.ts tsconfig.json .prettierrc.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:output
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run check && npm test
